text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Autumn). An autumn showdown 
against T.M. Opera O. Meisho Doto's goal 
is—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
At the Takarazuka Kinen, Opera O-san 
finally picked me as her first choice. 
So...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Today is the day I want to become a 
sparkling Umamusume just like Opera O-san, 
and have her acknowledge me as her 
partner!

After sending Meisho Doto off with a 
cheerful smile, what happened next was—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
So, did you find it? A way to break 
through the ceiling of those numbers?
choice_data_list:
No, but today's the day I definitely find 
it!
No, but today's the day I find it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hah! Like anything can be done in that 
short a time. Though if it really could...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I might... be seeing a breakthrough.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I don't understand complicated things... 
But...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
A ceiling blocking growth. If such a thing 
exists and is casting a shadow over Doto, 
its true identity must be...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Her true identity――maybe it was in plain 
sight all along. Even in your eyes, 
Trainer.

I gasped as it was pointed out to me. In 
this big autumn race, something might 
finally become crystal clear.
